description: ChefJoJo helps you save and use your favorite recipes. With ChatGPT, you can get help with your recipes like never before. Use ChatGPT to ask questions about your recipes and talk to it live while you're cooking. You can also use ChatGPT to create recipes for you and then save them in ChefJoJo.
